```{r}
story_order <- c("Dont Look", "Natalie Wood", "Sea Ice",
                 "Grandfather Clocks", "Impatient Billionaire", "Pool Party")

if (is.na("subject")) {
  stop("Couldn't find a subject column. Add one of: subject, subj, subject_id, participant, id, SID, Subject")
}

# 1) One value per (subject, story) by averaging events
subject_story <- story_data %>%
  group_by(.data[["subject"]], story) %>%
  summarise(z_pupil_story_mean = mean(z_pupil, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 2) Story-level summary across subjects (mean ± SE)
summary_story <- subject_story %>%
  group_by(story) %>%
  summarise(
    n      = dplyr::n(),  # number of subjects contributing to this story
    mean_z = mean(z_pupil_story_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_z   = sd(z_pupil_story_mean,   na.rm = TRUE),
    se_z   = ifelse(n > 1, sd_z / sqrt(n), 0),  # 0-length whisker if only 1 subject
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Valence mapping
if ("valence_label" %in% names(story_data)) {
  story_valence <- story_data %>%
    distinct(story, valence_label) %>%
    group_by(story) %>% slice_head(n = 1) %>% ungroup()
} else {
  story_valence <- tibble(
    story = story_order,
    valence_label = c("negative", "negative", "neutral",
                      "neutral", "positive", "positive")
  )
}

plot_df <- summary_story %>%
  left_join(story_valence, by = "story") %>%
  mutate(
    story = factor(story, levels = story_order),
    valence_label = factor(valence_label, levels = c("negative","neutral","positive"))
  )

# 3) Plot bars + SE error bars
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = story, y = mean_z, fill = valence_label)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, color = "black") +   # black outline on bars
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_z - se_z, ymax = mean_z + se_z),
    width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = story_order) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(negative = "#4575b4",  # softer blue
                               neutral  = "#bdbdbd",  # light gray
                               positive = "#d73027")) + # softer red
  labs(
    title = "Average Z-Scored Pupil by Story",
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Valence"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),   # remove major grid
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),   # remove minor grid
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r}
posterior_mean_draws <- function(x, n_draws = 8000,
                                 mu0 = 0, kappa0 = 1e-6,
                                 alpha0 = 0.001, beta0 = 0.001) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  n <- length(x)
  if (n < 1) stop("Not enough data in group to form a posterior.")

  xbar <- mean(x)
  ss   <- sum((x - xbar)^2)

  kappa_n <- kappa0 + n
  mu_n    <- (kappa0 * mu0 + n * xbar) / kappa_n
  alpha_n <- alpha0 + n / 2
  beta_n  <- beta0 + 0.5 * ss + (kappa0 * n * (xbar - mu0)^2) / (2 * kappa_n)

  df    <- 2 * alpha_n
  scale <- sqrt(beta_n / (alpha_n * kappa_n))

  mu_n + scale * rt(n_draws, df = df)
}

# If valence_label missing, map from story names (edit mapping if needed)
story_order <- c("Dont Look", "Natalie Wood", "Sea Ice",
                 "Grandfather Clocks", "Impatient Billionaire", "Pool Party")

if (!("valence_label" %in% names(story_data))) {
  story_valence <- tibble(
    story = story_order,
    valence_label = c("negative", "negative", "neutral",
                      "neutral", "positive", "positive")
  )
  story_data <- story_data %>% left_join(story_valence, by = "story")
}

# Keep only positive/negative
dat <- story_data %>%
  filter(valence_label %in% c("positive", "negative")) %>%
  select(valence_label, z_pupil) %>%
  filter(is.finite(z_pupil))

# Posterior draws for each group mean
draws_pos <- posterior_mean_draws(dat$z_pupil[dat$valence_label == "positive"])
draws_neg <- posterior_mean_draws(dat$z_pupil[dat$valence_label == "negative"])

# --------------------------------------------
# Pretty “boxed” posterior plot (like your example)
#   - histogram (density-scaled) in light blue
#   - dashed vline at 0
#   - bold 95% CI bar on baseline with endpoint labels
#   - annotation: mean and P(posterior > 0)
# --------------------------------------------
plot_posterior_boxed <- function(draws, title_text = NULL,
                                 hist_fill = "#9bd3e6") {
  # summaries
  m   <- mean(draws)
  pgt <- mean(draws > 0)
  ci  <- quantile(draws, c(0.025, 0.975))
  dens <- density(draws)
  ymax <- max(dens$y)

  # format labels
  mean_lab <- sprintf("Mean=%.3f", m)
  prob_lab <- sprintf("P(posterior > 0)=%.3f", pgt)

  df <- tibble(mu = draws)

  ggplot(df, aes(x = mu)) +
    # histogram scaled to density so baseline y=0 works nicely
    geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)),
                   bins = 40, fill = hist_fill, alpha = 0.8, color = NA) +
    # dashed line at zero
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.7) +
    # thick CI bar on the baseline with endpoint labels
    geom_segment(aes(x = ci[1], xend = ci[2], y = 0, yend = 0),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 3.0, lineend = "butt", color = "black") +
    annotate("text", x = ci[1], y = 0, label = sprintf("%.3f", ci[1]),
             vjust = -1.1, size = 4) +
    annotate("text", x = ci[2], y = 0, label = sprintf("%.3f", ci[2]),
             vjust = -1.1, size = 4) +
    # mean & probability annotations near top of the histogram
    annotate("text", x = m, y = 0.85 * ymax, label = mean_lab,
             size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = m, y = 0.72 * ymax, label = prob_lab,
             size = 4.5) +
    labs(
      x = "Posterior distribution",
      y = NULL,
      title = title_text
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, ymax * 1.05)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      # simple look like your example
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y  = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      # light background similar to a cream paper (optional)
      # panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#faf6f2", color = NA)
    )
}

# --------------------------------------------
# Build the two separate figures
# --------------------------------------------

# draws_pos <- posterior_mean_draws(dat$z_pupil[dat$valence_label == "positive"])
# draws_neg <- posterior_mean_draws(dat$z_pupil[dat$valence_label == "negative"])

p_pos <- plot_posterior_boxed(

  title_text = "Valence: Positive",
  hist_fill  = "#EFA3A3"
)

p_neg <- plot_posterior_boxed(
  draws_neg,
  title_text = "Valence: Negative",

)
```

```{r}
# ---- Compute per-(subject, story) averages ----
story_means <- story_data %>%
  group_by(subject, story) %>%
  summarise(avg_pupil = mean(.data[["z_pupil"]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

library(tidyr)
# Enforce complete 6x per subject: fill missing combos (if any) with NA and then drop with a warning
story_means <- story_means %>%
  tidyr::complete(subject, story = story_order) %>%
  arrange(subject, factor(story, levels = story_order))

# Warn if any subject-story cell was missing raw data
n_missing_cells <- sum(is.na(story_means$avg_pupil))
if (n_missing_cells > 0) {
  warning(glue("Detected {n_missing_cells} missing (subject, story) cells. These rows will be dropped for the model."))
}

# Keep only complete rows for modeling
story_means_model <- story_means %>% drop_na(avg_pupil)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
label_by_story <- story_data %>%
  dplyr::distinct(story, valence)

story_means_model <- story_means_model %>%
  dplyr::left_join(label_by_story, by = "story") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    valence = factor(valence, levels = c("negative","neutral","positive"))
  )

total_num_events <- data.frame(
  story = c("Pool Party", "Impatient Billionaire", "Sea Ice", "Grandfather Clocks", "Natalie Wood", "Dont Look"),
  total_num_events = c(7, 7, 8, 11, 17, 13)
)
story_means_model <- merge(story_means_model, total_num_events, by = "story", all.x = TRUE)

story_means_model$story<-as.factor(story_means_model$story)
story_means_model$valence<-as.factor(story_means_model$valence)
story_means_model$subject<-as.factor(story_means_model$subject)
story_means_model$valence <- relevel(story_means_model$valence, ref="neutral")

story_m1 <- lmer(avg_pupil ~ valence + (1 | subject) + (1|story) + total_num_events, data = story_means_model)
summary(story_m1)

story_m1_2 <- lmer(avg_pupil ~ valence + (1 | subject) + (1|story), data = story_means_model)
summary(story_m1_2)
```
